name: Schedule
description: Run prompts on a schedule. Adds the ScheduleCronCreate/ScheduleCronList/ScheduleCronDelete tools. The model schedules tasks from natural language like 'remind me at 3pm' or 'every 5 minutes check the deploy'. A 1-second heartbeat injects each due task's prompt between turns via the prompt.inject port. Also adds the /loop and /schedule commands. Tasks are session-scoped at ~/.minimal-agent/sessions/<sid>.cron.json and restored (unexpired) on --resume. Disable with MINIMAL_AGENT_DISABLE_CRON=1.

tool.name: CronCreate
tool.description: Schedule a prompt to run on a cron schedule or on an interval. Use it for a reminder, or to poll a deploy or a pull request until it settles. Do not use it to list or to cancel a task, use CronList or CronDelete for that. Do not schedule a push, a delete or a deploy unless the user already authorized it. Returns the new task, with its id, its schedule and its next fire time.

prompt.description: The prompt to run each time the task fires. Required. The text is injected as a user turn between turns, never mid-response.

cron.description: A standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), interpreted in LOCAL time. Supports *, ranges (1-5), steps (*/15), and lists (1,15,30). Example: '0 9 * * 1-5' = weekdays at 9am. Provide this OR `every`.

every.description: A human interval, converted to a clean cron cadence. Examples: '5m', '30m', '2h', '1d', 'every 2 hours'. Intervals that don't map to a clean cron step are rounded. Provide this OR `cron`.

recurs.description: Whether the task repeats. Default true. Set false for a one-shot reminder that deletes itself after it fires once. A session holds up to 50 tasks, and a recurring task expires after 7 days.

tool.name: CronList
tool.description: List the scheduled tasks of this session. Use it to answer which tasks exist, or before you cancel or reschedule one. Do not use it to change a task, use CronReschedule or CronDelete for that. Returns each task id, schedule, next fire time and prompt.

tool.name: CronDelete
tool.description: Cancel a scheduled task by its 8 character id. Use it when a task is done, or when the user no longer wants it. Do not use it to delay a task, use CronReschedule for that. Returns the removed id and the count of tasks that remain.

tool.name: CronReschedule
tool.description: Change the next fire time of a scheduled task. Use it to set a new cadence, or to delay a one-shot. Do not use it to create a task, use CronCreate for that. Returns the task id, the new cadence and the new next fire time.

every.description: A human interval like "30s", "5m", "2h". Sets a new recurring cadence. Mutually exclusive with `nextAtMs`.

nextAtMs.description: Absolute epoch-ms timestamp for the next fire. Single-use: the task re-arms with its existing cadence after firing. Mutually exclusive with `every`.

commands.name: loop
commands.summary: Run a prompt on repeat while the session is open

commands.name: schedule
commands.summary: Schedule a prompt by cron, or list/cancel tasks
